Read these sentences from paragraph 3.

I owe much to Paige. Buying a puppy from her meant having the freedom to pick her brain, no matter how often I called—calls that in the beginning were more frequent than she bargained for, I’m sure, and were typically panic-driven.

These sentences help characterize the author as —

options.label: A
options.text: discouraged by his dog’s initial behavior

options.label: B
options.text: surprised by Paige’s vast knowledge of dogs

options.label: C
options.text: regretful for taking advantage of Paige’s kindness

options.label: D
options.text: worried that he wasn’t caring for his dog correctly
